first_page: Podcast player page /podcasts/ for listeners who want any show without an account. First: search shows (iTunes Search, keyless) or paste an RSS link, episode list read from the feed through a small edge proxy, a player with speed, skip 15/30, resume position and a follow list kept on the device; Verse Out Loud pinned first. Will not build: paid subscriptions, recommendations, ratings or cross-device sync.
